game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the herald must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against bandits.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Watchtower Ring, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against bandits. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the potion value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the town gate using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The town gate reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the town gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Watchtower Ring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Watchtower Ring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The town gate reached with actions_used <= 22.
